links.rationale: The SVG renders a classic folded-corner document icon (16x16) with a page body, dog-eared top-right corner, and three horizontal lines representing text lines — a standard generic file/document symbol.

links.note: The SVG renders a rectangular window frame with a top bar — a standard browser/app window icon.
Three small circles (r=0.75) in the top-left area of the icon represent macOS-style traffic light window controls.
Traffic light dots are a visual element within the browser window icon design.
